    index("tasks_org_id_ix_a6108bd").on(table.orgId.asc().nullsLast()),
    pgPolicy("tasks_select_841c287", { as: "permissive", for: "select", to: ["public"], using: sql`true` }),
    pgPolicy("tasks_insert_7d725c8_0", { as: "permissive", for: "insert", to: ["public"], withCheck: sql`(SELECT rebase.uid()) IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT rebase.uid()) NOT IN ('anonymous', 'anon')` }),
    pgPolicy("tasks_update_7d725c8_1", { as: "permissive", for: "update", to: ["public"], using: sql`(SELECT rebase.uid()) IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT rebase.uid()) NOT IN ('anonymous', 'anon')`, withCheck: sql`(SELECT rebase.uid()) IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT rebase.uid()) NOT IN ('anonymous', 'anon')` }),
    pgPolicy("tasks_default_admin_read", { as: "permissive", for: "select", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("tasks_default_admin_write_insert", { as: "permissive", for: "insert", to: ["rebase_admin"], withCheck: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("tasks_default_admin_write_update", { as: "permissive", for: "update", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))`, withCheck: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("tasks_default_admin_write_delete", { as: "permissive", for: "delete", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("tasks_tenant_scope", { as: "restrictive", for: "all", to: ["public"], using: sql`((SELECT rebase.uid() IS NULL)) OR ((SELECT string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin','support'])) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."memberships" "_ex0" WHERE ("_ex0".org_id = "public"."tasks".org_id) AND (("_ex0".user_id)::text = (SELECT rebase.uid()))))`, withCheck: sql`((SELECT rebase.uid() IS NULL)) OR ((SELECT string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin','support'])) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."memberships" "_ex0" WHERE ("_ex0".org_id = "public"."tasks".org_id) AND (("_ex0".user_id)::text = (SELECT rebase.uid()))))` }),
])).enableRLS();

export const wiki = pgTable("wiki", {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    ownerId: text("owner_id"),
    visibility: text("visibility"),
    title: text("title")
}, (table) => ([
    pgPolicy("wiki_select_ad5ed8f", { as: "permissive", for: "select", to: ["public"], using: sql`((owner_id)::text = (SELECT rebase.uid())) OR (visibility = 'public')` }),
    pgPolicy("wiki_insert_e78fed1", { as: "permissive", for: "insert", to: ["public"], withCheck: sql`(length(title) > 3) AND ((owner_id)::text = (SELECT rebase.uid()))` }),
    pgPolicy("wiki_default_admin_read", { as: "permissive", for: "select", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("wiki_default_admin_write_insert", { as: "permissive", for: "insert", to: ["rebase_admin"], withCheck: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("wiki_default_admin_write_update", { as: "permissive", for: "update", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))`, withCheck: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("wiki_default_admin_write_delete", { as: "permissive", for: "delete", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
])).enableRLS();

export const postsRelations = drizzleRelations(posts, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "tags": many(postsTags, { relationName: "tags" })
}));

export const postsTagsRelations = drizzleRelations(postsTags, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "post_id": one(posts, {
        fields: [postsTags.post_id],
        references: [posts.id],
        relationName: "tags"
    }),
    "tag_id": one(tags, {
        fields: [postsTags.tag_id],
        references: [tags.id],
        relationName: "posts_tags_tag_id"
    })
}));

export const tables = { accounts, articles, boards, docs, flags, jobs, memberships, notes, posts, postsTags, projects, secrets, tags, tasks, wiki };
export const enums = {  };
export const relations = { postsRelations, postsTagsRelations };
